newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Energy abandons Amundsen test.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Energy abandons Amundsen test.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said Thursday that it will plug and abandon a 7,000 foot exploratory test on the Amundsen prospect in East Breaks Block 335 in the Flex Trend of the Gulf of Mexico.
The company owns a one-half working interest in the block while Reading & Bates Development Co owns the other half.

The company added that as a continuation of the program with Reading & Bates, it plans to commence drilling in August its Ruby prospect in Ewing Bank Blocks 919 and 920 and intends to drill two additional exploratory prospects in the Flex Trend before the end of 1997.
Santa Fe is an independent oil and gas exploration and development company.
